system.description: Before you cast a malediction, double its HP cost to alter one of its lifting conditions. The counterplay tax, priced correctly: every malediction's balance sits in its lifting condition, and this buys the right to move one at double the blood. Watch it against Induced Automatism — three targets is 30 HP printed, 60 amended — and rule that "alter" means rewrite, not delete, with a replacement the targets can actually attempt. Say it before it is used, not after.
